alternatives.reason: Roadmap G1 requires a real Cloud Run path; leaving it to Week 3 puts every deployment-evidence slice (VS-005, VS-006) behind an unverified cloud setup.
Persistence and model access are separate decisions; bundling them would hide which part of G1 actually passed.

architecture_impact: The Go service honours the Cloud Run container contract (PORT, 0.0.0.0, SIGTERM drain) while staying loopback-only without PORT.
The built React workspace is served by the same Go process with single-page fallback; no second runtime is introduced.
Fixture Project roots are baked into the image as explicit paths; there is still no filesystem scan, remote discovery or write path.
One staging Cloud Run service is the only cloud target; production remains a protected, undeployed threshold.
cost_assumptions: Cloud Run min-instances=0, max-instances=2, 256Mi; expected cost within free tier for demo traffic.
Cloud Build and Artifact Registry usage is minutes and a few hundred MB; unknown exact monthly figure stays UNKNOWN until billing export is checked.
unknowns: Actual GCP project id, region, billing state and deploying identity (G0 items).
Whether the organization policy allows an unauthenticated Cloud Run service; if not, the demo needs an IAM-authenticated invoker.
Docker daemon was unavailable in the verification workspace, so the image build itself is verified only by the first Cloud Build run.
acceptance_criteria: GET /healthz returns liveness only and rejects non-GET.
GET /v1/projects and /v1/projects/{id} keep the VS-002 contract and 405 on mutation methods.
GET / serves the built workspace; unknown client routes fall back to index.html; missing assets return 404; paths cannot escape the static root.
PORT selects 0.0.0.0:$PORT; without PORT the server binds 127.0.0.1:8080.
Existing Go, frontend and browser evidence stays green.

human_decision.reason: Owner instructed to start Week 1 work immediately (Cloud Run baseline for roadmap G1) with a single-operator, vibe-coding cadence. This accepts containerization and one staging service only; it does not authorize production, IAM beyond the demo invoker, persistence or model access.

human_review.mode: single-operator review via Claude Cowork prompts; tests not re-run (CI green); no independent reviewer separation claimed
accepted_boundaries: GCP project / region / billing / deploying identity 全部是 10/8 的 G0 事項
接受的是本機容器合約，不是 staging 部署授權
